evidence.summary: The US National Defense University’s study of the People’s Armed Police lists the PAP Special Police Academy among the PAP’s universities and academies, and CASI lists the People’s Armed Police Special Police College among the military academic institutions that planned to recruit high-school graduates in 2024.
